hypothesis: Selected syntax-only rules identify independent accepted cleanup targets with low false-positive rates on explicit retained/valid targets.
unitOfAnalysis: construct anchor for localization; PR and repository for inference
publicLabelSource: held-out public maintainer changes and explicit intentional/valid targets; Ruff/Bandit/typescript-eslint fixtures development only

deterministicPredictors.match: frozen syntax rule and configuration on complete target construct
deterministicPredictors.applicability: complete/unsupported/incomplete with enumerated syntax and binding reasons
deterministicPredictors.recommendation: match after declared source suppression; never reads validation labels

lanes.suppression: explicit source noqa:S110 suppresses recommendation only
lanes.ruleSource: native clean implementation or operator-prepared ast-grep; never copy scb-check into corpus

lanes.scope: synchronous loop, one assignment to statically known preexisting local dict; no filter/else/extra statements/named expression effects; otherwise unsupported
nested non-null assertion redundancy; no type-aware nullability inference

sampleOverride.development: all pinned fixtures plus known public examples; never validation

primaryEndpointOverride: sensitivity of contextual target detection subject to fixed FPR ceiling, separately per lane

decisionOverride.bounds: more conservative of exact binomial and repository hierarchical bootstrap
decisionOverride.refine: point pass but interval failure, or sensitivity>=0.65 and FPR<=0.10 with development-correctable failures; maximum one fresh reserve confirmation
decisionOverride.stop: sensitivity<0.65 or FPR>0.10 or hard failure or second failed confirmation
decisionOverride.incomplete: missing label quotas, source/provenance or parser observation; no substitution of unlabeled negatives

additionalPassGates.duplicateLocalization: one-to-one matching; extra candidate hits are FP

jevQuestions: Development only: is enough binding and surrounding context present?
implementationSteps: Statically extract pinned literal fixture cases and exact configuration.
Use known Ruff failures for refinement; test native or pinned rule identities.
Freeze three lanes before opening external validation.
Use one-to-one anchor matching with no many-to-many credit.
Evaluate lane-specific sensitivity/FPR/coverage and accepted-target clearing.
Emit optional evidence design only for passing lanes; never alter index.
holdouts: common.json sample and sources.json split; all historical evidence development-only
primaryEndpoint: sensitivity of contextual target detection subject to fixed FPR ceiling, separately per lane
passRefineStop: common.json thresholds plus additionalPassGates; A1 decisionOverride replaces statistical gate
sampleSizeRationale: roadmap primary statistical contract; A1 exact zero-FP bound and clustered sensitivity design
leakageProtections: public labels selected before native predictors
prediction hashes sealed before label join
no target metric selection or holdout tuning
nonInferiorityControls: common.json correctnessNonInferiority; all hard invariance controls apply
